eta/exclurad.F:1910:       SUBROUTINE BORNT(Q2,W,SINX,COSX,SINX2,COSX2,BORN,IR,CUT)
eta/exclurad.F:1915:       real BORN(6),GAMMA(6,3)

eta/exclurad.F:1931:C* IFLAG=0, VFLAG=0. WOULD GET RIDE OF MAGNETIC AND PV EXTRA TERM
eta/exclurad.F:1933:       IF(IR.EQ.1.OR.IR.EQ.2)XMPI=XMPI0
eta/exclurad.F:1934:       IF(IR.EQ.3.OR.IR.EQ.4)XMPI=XMPIP
eta/exclurad.F:1935:       PI=4.0*ATAN(1.0)
eta/exclurad.F:1936:       GG=SQRT(4.*PI*GN)
eta/exclurad.F:1937:C*  THE PI-N COUPLING CONSTANT
eta/exclurad.F:1938:       GEP=1./(1.+3.04*Q2+1.54*Q2*Q2+0.068*Q2*Q2*Q2)
eta/exclurad.F:1939:       CAP=Q2/(4.*XMP*XMP)
eta/exclurad.F:1960:       FP(3)=EC/(1.+Q2/0.5)
eta/exclurad.F:1963:C* PION FORM FACTOR.
eta/exclurad.F:1964:       S=W**2
eta/exclurad.F:1965:       Q0=(S-XMP**2-Q2)/(2.*W)
eta/exclurad.F:1966:       Q=SQRT(Q2+Q0**2)
eta/exclurad.F:1967:       E1=(S+XMP**2+Q2)/(2.*W)
eta/exclurad.F:1968:       E2=(S+XMP**2-XMPI**2)/(2.*W)
eta/exclurad.F:1970:       P0=SQRT(P**2+XMPI**2)
eta/exclurad.F:1971:       T=2.*Q*P*COSX-2.*Q0*P0+XMPI**2-Q2
eta/exclurad.F:1972:       U=-2.*Q*P*COSX-2.*Q0*E2+XMP**2-Q2
eta/exclurad.F:1974:	 GAMMA(1,J)=0.5*GG*F1(J)
eta/exclurad.F:1975:	 GAMMA(2,J)=-GG*F1(J)/(T-XMPI**2)
eta/exclurad.F:1976:	 GAMMA(3,J)=-0.5*GG*F2(J)
eta/exclurad.F:1977:	 GAMMA(4,J)=GAMMA(3,J)
eta/exclurad.F:1978:	 GAMMA(5,J)=0.5*GAMMA(2,J)
eta/exclurad.F:1979:	 GAMMA(6,J)=0.
eta/exclurad.F:1983:	 A(I,J)=(1./(S-XMP**2)+EPS(J)*ETA(I)/(U-XMP**2))*GAMMA(I,J)
eta/exclurad.F:1993:       IF (Q2.EQ.0.) THEN
eta/exclurad.F:1997:	 A(5,J)=(1./(S-XMP**2)+ETA(5)/(U-XMP**2))*GAMMA(5,J)
eta/exclurad.F:1998:     C	 +0.5*(1.-EPS(J))*2.*GG/Q2*(FP(J)-F1(J))/(T-XMPI**2)
eta/exclurad.F:1999:	 A(6,J)=(1./(S-XMP**2)+ETA(6)/(U-XMP**2))*GAMMA(6,J)
eta/exclurad.F:2002:       SQ2=SQRT(2.0)

eta/exclurad.F:2011:       FC=1./(8.*PI*W)

eta/exclurad.F:2034:       B(2,6)=Q2/(W+XMP)
eta/exclurad.F:2036:       B(3,2)=(S-XMP**2+Q2/2.)/(W+XMP)
eta/exclurad.F:2039:       B(3,5)=-Q2/(W+XMP)
eta/exclurad.F:2042:       B(4,2)=-(S-XMP**2+Q2/2.)/(W-XMP)
eta/exclurad.F:2045:       B(4,5)=Q2/(W-XMP)
